Class ProxyConfig.Builder

java.lang.Object
io.r2dbc.proxy.callback.ProxyConfig.Builder
Enclosing class:
ProxyConfig
public static final class ProxyConfig.Builder extends Object
Builder for creating a ProxyConfig. For attributes not specified explicitly, default values are used.
